text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City talks with Tamamo Cross before the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once again, Tamamo Cross asks why Gold City runs. This time, Gold City admits she has no real answer other than the simple desire to run and win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And for Gold City, that's good enough. She heads off to the race in high spirits!
